heading: Application for Graduate Analyst – Data, AI, Solutions & Engineering
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Analyst Programme in the Data, AI, Solutions & Engineering business unit because it combines the technical and analytical work I already do with the consulting and client-facing dimension I want to build. The opportunity to work on real client projects from day one, alongside experienced consultants who provide structured learning and mentoring, is exactly the environment I need to grow both technically and professionally. I am available for a September 2027 start and comfortable with the hybrid working arrangement.

My background combines practical IT support and security work with formal analytical training. I am an MSc Information Security graduate from Royal Holloway, awarded with Merit, with CompTIA Security+ and ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity, preceded by a BCA in computer applications. That means I understand not only how to resolve technical problems but how to approach complex challenges in a structured way - which is central to a role that requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, data literacy, and the ability to translate client requirements into practical solutions.

In my current IT support position I am the first point of contact for 15 colleagues across 15 to 20 devices, troubleshooting access and system problems, monitoring server health and maintaining network and website-access controls. I handle four to five access requests a day through on-premises Active Directory - verifying business approval, granting time-limited permissions and documenting the access period and any extension - and I investigate four to five suspicious emails a day, recording findings and alerting colleagues to recurring tactics. I also built a local tool that maps Windows error codes to their common causes and used it to trace intermittent server freezes to missing or corrupted DLLs, which is the kind of structured problem-solving and root-cause analysis Baringa values. My technical skills include Python, PowerShell and SQL, which I use for task automation and data analysis.

Two things in your requirements I want to be straightforward about. I have not worked in a formal consulting role or delivered client-facing projects, so that experience is something I would expect to develop through Baringa's Analyst Development Programme rather than claim as existing depth. What I do bring is a genuine analytical mindset and attention to detail: at Co-op, as Person in Charge, I conduct weekly risk assessments and daily compliance checks, maintain the assessment records, and coordinate seven or eight colleagues per shift while explaining requirements to people who have no particular interest in them. I am used to being the person who keeps the record straight and follows the correct process, and I am comfortable working with people from different backgrounds and disciplines.

What draws me to Baringa specifically is the focus on data, AI and digital innovation across sectors that are undergoing significant transformation - energy, financial services, government and telecoms. The opportunity to contribute to that work through a structured graduate programme with real responsibility and mentoring is exactly the kind of challenge I am looking for. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and experience could contribute to your team.
